regions.region: page 1 title, authors, abstract, keywords, and DOI
regions.finding: The source-derived article title and DOI were verified. The article discusses online Supporting Information only on a later page; workspace SI association remains unestablished and no SI facts were imported.
Four cited prior-work reaction classes were classified as literature examples; the lower Pd/H+ arrow was classified as the generic current scheme. None was assigned a current table-row yield.

The narrative outcomes for L1–L6 and Pd(PPh3)4 were linked to seven Scheme 2 optimization records shown on page 2. Recovery remains distinct from product yield, and trace/no-product outcomes were not forced to zero.

unresolved: Scheme 1 structures contain generic R groups and do not define unique compounds.
Ligand-screen workups, internal standard, and isolated yields are not reported.
No machine structure is chemically verified.

regions.region: page 2 upper-left Scheme 2 ligand screen and footnotes
regions.finding: Seven distinct ligand/catalyst conditions were retained with exact shared charges, loadings, solvent, nitrogen atmosphere, row time override, NMR yield/trace, and recovered 1a values.

regions.region: page 2 left-center Table 1 entries 1–11 and footnotes
regions.finding: Eleven independent optimization rows were retained with solvent, additive or omission, boron reagent, time overrides, NMR yield including trace, and recovered 1a. Water in entry 3 is an explicit participant; entry 8's 1.5-equiv override is preserved without inferred mmol.

regions.region: page 2 right-column Scheme 3 entries 3aa–3as and footnotes
regions.finding: Nineteen independent boronic-acid scope experiments were retained with common conditions, row-specific 36/24/19 h, 40 °C, or 10 mol% acid overrides, and isolated yields. Detailed 3aa–3am procedures on pages 4–6 enrich these rows rather than duplicating them.
The prose introduces the distinct propargylic-alcohol scope entries displayed on page 3; records use the page-3 row evidence rather than creating narrative duplicates.

unresolved: Table 1 entry 8's exact row-specific boronic-acid mmol charge is not printed.
Most scope entries lack detailed workup/product masses within pages 1–6.
Compact scope structures remain unverified candidates.

regions.region: page 3 upper-left Scheme 4 entries 3ba–3io and footnotes
regions.finding: Ten distinct propargylic-alcohol scope experiments were retained with shared conditions, isolated yields, and row-specific acid-loading/time/temperature overrides.
The 5.0 mmol/1.4572 g/91% 3ao scale-up remains distinct from the 1.0 mmol scope run. The optically active (R)-1a experiment separately retains 96% starting ee, 55% yield, and 2% product ee.
The Pd/H+ catalytic cycle and racemization sequence are a proposed mechanism; I, II, II', and III are not isolated reaction records.

regions.region: page 3 center-right Table 2 entries 1–4 and footnote
regions.finding: Four distinct chiral-ligand screens were retained with exact shared charges/loadings, 60 °C/16 h/N2 conditions, source dashes for yield/ee, explicit failure to afford 3aa, and recovered 1a values.
The GLP-1 and glucose-consumption assays are biological evaluations, not chemical reaction records; their result tables continue on page 4 and were not converted into synthesis experiments.

unresolved: Many Scheme 4 structures and operational workups are not detailed on pages 1–6.
The page-3 chiral-substrate arrow omits exact scale/solvent volume and ee measurement method.

regions.region: page 4 left column Tables 3 and 4 plus conclusions
regions.finding: The page contains GLP-1-release and glucose-consumption bioassay tables and conclusions, not chemical reaction arrows. No synthesis record was fabricated from these assays.

Shared analytical conventions, vial use, anhydrous dioxane preparation, reaction-block temperature convention, and CH2Br2 NMR-yield standard were inspected as context rather than independent reactions.

regions.region: page 4 right-column Typical Procedure and preparation of 3aa
regions.finding: Scheme 3 3aa was enriched with exact 1.0 mmol charges, glovebox/N2 charging and sealing, 25 °C/17 h, short-silica/EtOAc workup, CH2Br2 35 uL, 77% NMR yield, chromatography, 216.8 mg, 81% isolated yield, and 99% purity.

Scheme 3 3ab was enriched with exact Pd(PPh3)4/p-tolylboronic acid/(PhO)2POOH/1a/dioxane charges, 25 °C, 255.0 mg, 92% isolated yield, and petroleum-ether chromatography; characterization continues on page 5.

unresolved: Bioactivity assays are outside reaction-record scope.
3ab analytical characterization continues on page 5 but does not define another experiment.

regions.finding: Spectroscopic characterization completes the page-4 3ab paragraph; no duplicate preparation was created.
Three distinct Scheme 3 rows were enriched with exact charges, 25 °C conditions, chromatography, isolated masses/yields, reported purities where printed, and the 64.3–68.4 °C melting range for 3ae.
Two distinct scope rows were enriched with exact charges, chromatography, isolated masses/yields, and the reported 91% purity of 3ag.
Scheme 3 3ah was enriched with exact charges, the row-specific 36 h time, staged chromatography, 269.4 mg/88% isolated product, and 95% purity; characterization continues on page 6.

unresolved: 3ah characterization continues on page 6 without creating another experiment.

regions.finding: Spectroscopic characterization completes the existing 3ah preparation; it is not a second run.

regions.region: page 6 left column preparations of 3ai and 3aj
regions.finding: Scheme 3 rows 3ai/3aj were enriched with exact printed quantities, row-specific 36 h times, chromatography, product masses/yields, and 97%/91% purities. The 3ai boronic-acid number 304.1 lacks a printed unit and was not forced to mg.
The 40 °C 3ak row was enriched with exact printed quantities, staged chromatography, and 212.7 mg/74% product. The boronic-acid number 294.0 lacks a printed unit and remains unresolved.
The 3al row retains the 10 mol% acid/24 h overrides, exact charges including 25.2 mg/0.10 mmol acid, staged chromatography, and 237.0 mg/78% isolated product.
The 3am row retains the 19 h override, exact charges, staged chromatography, 236.4 mg/81% isolated product, and 56.3–59.4 °C melting range.

unresolved: The source omits mass units after 304.1 for 3ai boronic acid and 294.0 for 3ak boronic acid; neither unit was inferred.
All product SMILES remain unverified candidates.
No page beyond 6 is claimed as covered.
